signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the product experience of the self-serve journey for a defined set of surfaces — from signup and onboarding through activation and upgrade.

Partner with Marketing, CX, and Design to keep the experience consistent across touchpoints.
Work with Engineering to scope and deliver improvements that reduce time-to-value.
